critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/label-templates (line 3717-3725) does no company_id / auth validation — any client can create templates under any company_id. Consistent with existing endpoints but worth noting for future multi-tenant hardening.

server.py PUT /api/label-templates/{id} does not verify company_id in the payload matches the template's company_id — if allowed keys were expanded this could enable cross-tenant escalation. Currently safe because company_id is not in the allowed set.

LabelDesigner.jsx line 121 emits <option> whose child is dynamically wrapped in a <span> by the emergent instrumentation, producing a React dev-only hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>'). Non-blocking; source code is clean and this warning is invisible in production builds.

PUT /api/label-templates handler silently ignores unknown keys (good) but also allows partial page/elements replacement without shape validation — a client could store malformed elements[] causing rendering crashes. Consider adding Pydantic model for label templates.
